title: OCSO Latin proper: branch-specific confirmations and the shared 1983 book

traditions.label: Cistercians of the Strict Observance (OCSO)
traditions.scope: Postconciliar Latin Mass-proper components and their relation to the Roman Missal base, the OCist branch, and named house reception.
traditions.coverage_note: The official 1975 notice confirms OCSO prayers and reading indications; the shared Ritual identifies a Rome 1983 proper whose OCist publication and 1977 confirmation are independently attested. The overview's general 1983 approval report remains discrepant. No whole OCSO Missal, continuous use, inherited text or medieval OCSO identity is established.

sources.title: Notitiae 11 (1975), nos. 111–112, OCSO proper confirmation
sources.inspection: Whole journal issue acquired; printed p. 343/PDF p. 61 visually checked on 2026-10-20. CD 83/75, 16 September 1975, names OCSO Latin prayers and reading indications for its proper Masses.
sources.limitations: Official published summary; original signed decree and attached texts not acquired. No book title, imprint, first celebration or whole-missal scope is supplied.

sources.title: Rituale Cisterciense, Langwaden 1998, shared Latin Ritual
sources.inspection: Title/presentation/contents at PDF pp. 2–5, Missale adhibendum at PDF p. 24/printed p. 43, and proper references/additions at PDF pp. 45–46/printed pp. 85–87 visually checked. Printed p. 85 identifies OCSO CD 83/75 of 16 September 1975 and OCist CD 452/77 of 9 May 1977, then refers to Missae propriae ad usum Ordinis Cisterciensis, Rome 1983. Printed p. 86 contains Maria Gabriella's Latin collect.
sources.limitations: Later shared witness; proper itself is referred to another book. The 1971 reply is reproduced in a later edition, not acquired as an original signed instrument. Prayer payload is withheld; no whole-book collation or universal house-use census was performed.

sources.title: Notitiae 19 (1983), no. 203, official OCist book bibliography
sources.inspection: Printed p. 329/PDF p. 43 visually checked: under Ordo Cisterciensis, Latin Missae Propriae and Missae Propriae – Lectionarium, Curia Generalis Ordinis, Rome 1983; both confirmed 9 May 1977 under CD 452/77.
sources.limitations: An official publication bibliography, not the book or a new 1983 approval. Its heading is OCist, whose scope must not be silently transferred to OCSO.

sources.title: DLI holding record 83442, Missae propriae with Lectionarium, Rome 1983
sources.inspection: Whole catalogue HTML read: Latin title; Sighard Kleiner and General Chapter mandate; Rome 1983; 128, 96 pages; Lectionarium included; Lesesaal EDZ OCist, 1983; catalogue states there is no digitization.
sources.limitations: Catalogue identity only. Original book title/approval/body leaves and its physical completeness are unexamined. Catalogue author/branch identity is corroborated by the official bibliography, not proof of OCSO-owned printing or actual use.

sources.title: Notitiae 19 (1983), no. 200, Maria Gabriella text and house-calendar grants
sources.inspection: Printed pp. 139–140/PDF pp. 37–38 visually checked: OCSO CD 124/83 of 14 February confirms Latin/Italian collect and Office second reading; CD 125/83 of 3 February grants 22 April at four houses, obligatory at Vitorchiano, optional at Tre Fontane, Frattocchie and Valserena. Separate OCist CD 203/83 has 5 February date.
sources.limitations: Published summaries, not original signed instruments or attached texts. The Office second reading is not a Mass lection. Local authorization is not proof that a celebration took place.

sources.title: Notitiae 19 (1983), no. 201, OCSO Maria Gabriella order-calendar grant
sources.inspection: Printed p. 202/PDF p. 16 visually checked: OCSO, 5 March 1983, Prot. 330/83, permission for an annual optional memorial on 22 April in the order's calendar.
sources.limitations: Does not establish actual implementation everywhere, an exact proper edition used, or repeal of Vitorchiano's higher local grade. No general 1983 approval of all Cistercian prayers is stated.

sources.title: Vitorchiano, Maria Gabriella centenary celebration report, 2 May 2014
sources.inspection: Whole house HTML acquired and read, article lines 484 and 489–499. Original publication date 2 May 2014; later modification 5 August 2024. It reports the celebration deferred from 22 April because of the Easter octave, Mass opening the festive day, and sisters of Valserena participating.
sources.limitations: The report establishes one later house celebration. It names no exact Missal or proper printing, language, collect wording or Mass readings, and establishes no universal OCSO reception.

stages.label: 1975 OCSO Latin proper prayers and reading indications
stages.scope: Latin prayers and indications for readings of OCSO proper Masses; the attached proper and its first printing are uninspected.
stages.witness_label: OCSO component confirmation CD 83/75, published in Notitiae 11 (1975), p. 343
stages.summary: The published Congregation notice confirms OCSO Latin proper prayers and reading indications in 1975. It precedes the Rome 1983 printing named by the later shared Ritual.

evidence.claim: The confirmation expressly names the Strict Observance branch, date and Latin component extent.
The shared Ritual distinguishes OCSO 1975 from OCist 1977 confirmation and refers to the Rome 1983 proper.

stages.limitations: A scoped component approval, not evidence of a whole independent OCSO Missal, complete text, original printed book identity or new 1983 general approval. No continuity or parentage edge is drawn.
stages.reception: Order-directed confirmation, without a checked 1975 first celebration or named house's use of the attached Latin texts.

stages.label: 1983 Latin Cistercian proper and lectionary referenced for OCSO
stages.scope: The named complementary Latin Mass proper and Lectionarium, issued by the OCist General Curia and referred to by the shared OCist/OCSO Ritual.
stages.witness_label: Missae propriae ad usum Ordinis Cisterciensis, Rome 1983; DLI 83442
stages.summary: The official bibliography identifies both Latin components as Rome 1983 publications with a 1977 OCist confirmation. The later shared Ritual places this book beside the separate OCSO 1975 proper approval.

evidence.claim: Both complementary Latin books were issued in Rome in 1983 and confirmed for OCist under CD 452/77 on 9 May 1977.

evidence.locus: Title, mandate, year, extent, contents and shelfmark fields
evidence.claim: The exact catalogued title includes a Lectionarium and has 128, 96 pages.
The shared Latin Ritual refers to the named Rome 1983 book after distinguishing the two branches' approvals.

stages.limitations: Original book unacquired. The shared reference does not prove identical OCist and OCSO texts, blanket reception of every component, a new approval in 1983, or an OCSO-owned whole Missal. No substantive revision or inheritance is asserted.
stages.reception: A later common Ritual directs readers to the book; use of an exact 1983 copy, language and readings at any OCSO house is unestablished.

stages.label: 1983 Maria Gabriella collect and distinct local/order calendar grants
stages.date_label: 3 February house grant; 14 February text confirmation; 5 March order-calendar grant, 1983
stages.scope: Maria Gabriella's Latin Mass collect and 22 April OCSO observance; the companion Office reading and Italian expression remain identified but outside this Latin Mass state's text extent.
stages.witness_label: CD 124/83, CD 125/83 and Prot. 330/83; later Latin collect witness in Ritual 1998 p. 86
stages.summary: The Latin collect has its own confirmation. Four houses receive a separately ranked observance before a later optional memorial is granted in the order's calendar. These are bounded additions, not a general proper approval.

evidence.claim: Text confirmation and the four-house calendar grant have distinct protocols, dates and scope; Vitorchiano has a higher rank.
The later grant permits an order-calendar optional memorial on 22 April.
The shared Ritual lists later addition protocols and supplies a Latin Maria Gabriella collect.

evidence.locus: Article published 2 May 2014, opening and Mass paragraphs
evidence.claim: The house reports a later celebration with Mass, deferred from 22 April because of the Easter octave.

stages.limitations: Original signed instruments and the earliest attached collect remain unacquired. No Mass lection is inferred from the Office second reading. No original-before text is collated, so there is no revision edge from the 1975 proper and no assumed identity with the 1983 printed book's contents.
stages.reception: Permissions name houses and order scope separately. Vitorchiano's report supplies one later actual Mass celebration, without identifying the exact book, language or collect used. It does not prove every house used the proper or date its first use.

gaps.missing: The distinct Strict Observance branch's exact Mass-book sequence, branch-specific approvals, and named-house reception from the 1892 separation to the 1971 Roman Missal adoption faculty have not been established in this continuation.
gaps.next_source: Original OCSO General Chapter and liturgy records after 1892, identified preconciliar Latin Mass books and their approval leaves, and dated house book inventories or adoption records; reconcile earlier monastic receipt leads without treating catalogue association as proof of branch-wide reception.
gaps.consequence: The new postconciliar states do not fill the 1892–1971 interval or establish continuous OCSO reception. Shared earlier Cistercian material does not create a medieval OCSO institutional identity.

gaps.missing: Original signed reply 525/70 of 8 June 1971; signed OCSO CD 83/75 with attached prayers/reading indications; signed OCist CD 452/77; exact Rome 1983 Mass proper and Lectionarium; resolution of the overview's reported 1983 general approval.
gaps.next_source: Order archives and public library copies, beginning with DLI 83442 (128, 96 pages); compare branch-specific approval and title leaves against the official 1975 notice, 1983 bibliography and shared 1998 Ritual.
gaps.consequence: No whole OCSO Missal, exact complete text, substantive before/after revision or automatic relation to the older Cistercian whole-missal line is claimed.

gaps.missing: Edition identity and approval of the official undated Latin DOC reading supplement, relation to the 1983 printed Lectionarium, original later-addition instruments, and exact books used by OCSO houses.
gaps.next_source: Render the order's Lectionario-cisterciense-LA.doc; acquire the 1983 book and original 1983/1992/1995 instruments named by Ritual p. 85; use dated house ordines and celebrations that identify exact books and language. The 2019 Atlas directive is a separate permission/reception control.
gaps.consequence: File metadata dates do not create a 2010 revision. Named permissions and one house celebration do not establish uniform reception, exact Latin-book use or modern full-text publication rights.
